note: Owner observations, recorded verbatim. Written ONLY from the owner's explicit answers. A row absent from this file stays PENDING in the generated matrix; nothing here is ever inferred, defaulted or upgraded from a measurement. NOT TESTED is a final result, not a placeholder for PASS.

sessions.context: guided inspection over adb, watch on wrist and on desk, Groups A and B plus the permission row of Group C

AOD brightness.note: Comfortable in the lighting at the time of inspection.

AOD post-cycle render visually intact.note: Judged from matrix/after_aod_cycles.png, the frame captured immediately after 10 sleep/wake cycles.

Date readability.note: "yeah its grey on grey" / "looks off-center too"

Edge clipping.note: No content clipped and no gap at the rim through the tilt range.

No prompt or unexpected permission behav.note: No prompt, nothing odd. No consent dialog at install, at activation or since.

outstanding.Heart rate agrees with the watch's own r: OPEN. Two attempts on 2026-07-27, neither usable. (1) Owner read 130 bpm while away from the home network. (2) Owner read 98 bpm; adb returned 'No route to host' at the last known address 192.168.1.183:38371, so no recording was possible. Neither number is evidence: a comparison is only meaningful when the watch reading and the balance-wheel recording are SIMULTANEOUS. Neither 130 nor 98 may be paired with the earlier 104.1 bpm measurement or with any later recording.
outstanding.Heart rate tracks after exertion: OPEN. Not performed. Note that a rise in the WATCH's own reading is not evidence the FACE received it - only the implied rate measured from the balance wheel demonstrates that.
outstanding.Heart rate falls back off-wrist: OPEN. Not performed. Requires adb reachability to record the wheel. The implied rate must collapse to exactly 70.0 bpm (1.1667 Hz).
outstanding.Final owner disposition: OPEN. Deferred until after the wear sessions, which is when the judgement is meaningful. Covers all six Group D rows.

resume_procedure.blocker: adb reachability. The watch and this machine must be on the same network, and the wireless-debugging IP:port changes every session (Settings > Developer options > Wireless debugging).
steps: confirm AURELIUS is the ACTIVE face and on screen (the probe records the panel)
owner reads HR from the watch, switches back to AURELIUS, states the number
owner performs brief safe exertion, reads HR again, returns to AURELIUS
tools/hr_probe.sh <IP>:<PORT> post_exertion   # implied rate must RISE vs rest
owner removes the watch, sets it face-up, waits for the sensor to drop out
tools/hr_probe.sh <IP>:<PORT> off_wrist       # implied rate must be 70.0 bpm
record results in OWNER_OBSERVATIONS.json, then device_matrix.py --rebuild-doc
resume_procedure.exertion_is_optional: NOT TESTED is a valid final result and must never be inferred from the other readings.
